READING THE SPEC — severity markers (ateles#359). The spec above was written by the review lenses, so it may contain `[BLOCKING]` and `[NON-BLOCKING]` markers. They do not mean 'the author must address them before opening'; you ARE the author, and addressing them IS the build. Some are explicitly conditional ('this becomes [BLOCKING] if X'); treat those as forward-looking notes unless the condition holds today. The pre-impl gates are already green — a marker in the spec is not an open gate. Satisfy what you can within scope, note in the PR body anything you deliberately deferred and why, and OPEN THE PR.
